fidelityRules.rule: validated means human artistic review, not image generation or decode success.
Character/version/equipment/action/posture/native-facing are separate dimensions. No automatic mirror, recolor, interpolation or held duplicate counted as an authored drawing.
Measure native-alpha gutters without rewriting pixels; alpha3 on an edge remains visible/rejected. Rect/pivot metadata are allowed, not destructive CPU cleanup.
Static NPC renderer currently mirrors for requested facing. This preserves one static identity and must not be counted as independent native opposite-side art.
OPS-F22 already verified, art review open. OPS-F23 P1 explicitly reuses six existing same-role drawings; these are not six missing PNG files.

promptLocks: Actual scene role and identity from references, no generic Predator substitute.
Whole silhouette, all extremities/weapons/dreads inside native frame with transparent gutters, stable character scale.
Real transparent_background true; no black painted backdrop, checkerboard, floor, cast shadow, fog, halo, text or labels.
Four external mandibles when visible; preserve character lineage anatomy, mask silhouette, costume and anatomical equipment ownership.
Feral: no classical fishnet, no shoulder caster; segmented shield belongs anatomical left, wrist blades right.
Scar runtime-default: separate from Celtic and PHG Scar adaptation, preserve recorded kit state; do not turn a reference prop into canon proof.
Draw genuinely new phases/native directions; no copied identical cell, CSS mirror, recolor or rig counted as newly authored animation.
Keep original image bytes/prompts/references and hashes; metadata rectangles/pivots only.
